Inside the machine
Prime Ignorance is a playable C++ learning prototype set in 3021. Its characters, pixel art, world, and audio are original. It takes atmospheric inspiration from Undertale and room exploration from The Binding of Isaac.
Built with native Canvas, JavaScript, and the MIT-licensed CodeMirror 5 editor. Real C++20 compilation by Compiler Explorer. This public service has no uptime guarantee.
The full curriculum is preserved in CURRICULUM.md. See the research & asset shortlist and game design.
This prototype introduces every curriculum region. Advanced topics require the expanded projects, review, and spaced practice described in the curriculum before mastery can be claimed.
